With [#GitHubUniverse](https://hachyderm.io/tags/GitHubUniverse) around the corner there are a lot of things shipping! And the Actions team hasn't been idling over the last year. So many security improvements while battling attacks left and right.

But there is also some work required to benefit:

[https://jessehouwing.net/secure-github-actions-keep-the-creepy-crawlies-out-of-you-workflows/](https://jessehouwing.net/secure-github-actions-keep-the-creepy-crawlies-out-of-you-workflows/)

I'll be at [#GitHubUniverse](https://hachyderm.io/tags/GitHubUniverse) in little over a week! Let's connect! Ping me on any of my socials or reach out through

[https://events.xebia.com/microsoft/github/github-universe-2026](https://events.xebia.com/microsoft/github/github-universe-2026)
